note: Visual checks of the operator status page: what a person actually sees. The technical and product gates read machine reports; a page can be technically correct and visually wrong (a failing row rendered green, a verdict buried under the fold, a blank render). Each scenario states what a user must see and what must never be visible, and the screenshot is kept so a human or the agent can look at the layout.

scenarios.title: the page renders the two verdicts a user came for
scenarios.why: an operator opens this page to answer one question - are we accepted? - and a page that does not answer it is decoration

scenarios.title: no failing row is rendered in the page at all
scenarios.why: a green page that still lists failures teaches the operator to distrust the page, which is worse than showing nothing

scenarios.title: the loop state and the queue are visible, not merely present in the JSON
scenarios.why: round, risk and the queued tasks are what tells an operator whether the loop is alive; if they are not on the page they are not being read
